summary: Describes requirements for, and use of, the GMPLS control plane to support Virtual Concatenation and the Link Capacity Adjustment Scheme. These layer 1 inverse multiplexing mechanisms let the capacity of a group of channels be resized without interruption, in optical transport and SONET/SDH networks.

eli5.summary: Virtual concatenation lets several small data channels act as one big one. This explains how a network's control software sets that up and changes its size without cutting off traffic.

questions: hitless resizing of inverse multiplex group
